The Ministry of the Treasury has announced a wide ranging economic plan to stimulate the economy and promote growth beyond the currently booming construction sector:

[List]
[*]Interest rates will be cut to lower mortgage costs, making home ownership more affordable and promote real estate investment.
[*]The government will provide subsidised loans to businesses through private banks, primarily aimed at the industrial sector, to decrease unemployment and increase economic output.
[*]The government will aim to sign more trade agreements to open up more markets and lower trade barriers for Dhornaper's businesses, primarily with Shamatine nations within the SSP.
[*]Invest further into education to provide a highly skilled workforce for the industrial sector.
[/list]

The Ministry of the Treasury believes these measures will increase GDP Growth in excess of the current 6%, fuelled largely by the construction sector, and diversify Dhornaper's economy further.

[quote=irocco;60997850][b]The Sealiph of Irocco, Bearer of the Seal of Interpretation

To Hanniel Magon, First Suffet of [nation=noflag]Qartena Hadasht[/nation]

In the Name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful[/b]

Firstly, I would like to congratulate your state on this recent expansion to re-establish the natural borders of the Ancient Republic of Qartena Hadasht, though the morality of it is questioned by some within my Court. Nonetheless, I understand the struggles of incorporating new people, as a mere twenty-five years ago I annexed the Republic of Sybu. However, we have the boon of their population being much less than ours. As it stands currently, the Assembly of Iyaiids remains suspicious of you; however, the Itiammudian Islamic Airforce, bearing witness to your aircraft's capabilities, has lobbied me during a recent meeting in the Council of National Defence and Offence. Thus, I have reached out to you.

We would like to both enter into diplomatic negotiations with Qartena Hadasht regarding the formalisation of diplomacy, and discuss the purchase of a number of Qartena Hadasht aircraft for the Itiammudian Islamic Airforce. Though, of course, this is all contingent on your response and diplomatic inquiry if we reach that stage. It is believed by myself, and a number of those in both of the 	
Consultative Assemblies and the Council of National Defence and Offence, that entering into relations outside our standard station is wise for the preservation of Pan-Shamatine ideals, and that coagulation with other Shamatine states is wise for the preservation of our sovereignty against these foreigners.

I hope for a swift and positive response to be sent to my station at Imdekka, though we understand if coldness is returned to our offer. 

Peace be upon those who follow the guidance,

Bearer of the Seal of Interpretation,
Sealiph,

	
Ibrahim ibn Gakh'ud Al Iyaiid[/quote]

[b]Hanniel Magon, First Suffet of Qartena Hadasht

to The Sealiph of Irocco, Bearer of the Seal of Interpretation
Ibrahim ibn Gakh'ud Al Iyaiid[/b]

Peace be upon you, honored one. We appreciate your words of kindness which have been delivered to my Office. I understand that our two great nations have differences of opinion when it comes to a great many things. However, we would be honored to host representatives from your nation so that we may enter into these negotiations. While we hope to one day ease your people's suspicions of us, we understand the necessity of skepticism in the modern age. I can assure you that we also believe in the Pan-Shamatine approach to continental unity, and in response to acts of foreign aggression. Many foreign powers exist on our continental lands, and even more will if we are not strong. 

We are more than happy to hear both requests, and we do not see any reason as to why we would not be able to honor both of your requests. Hopefully we will soon be able to establish embassies for ease of future communication. 

May peace be upon you, and your peoples. 

The First Suffete of Qartena Hadasht
Hanniel Magon.

Commander of the Haras, Irman the Stern Al Iyaiid, stands before Sealiph Ibrahim like he had many times before. However, something feels off; it is as if the old man standing before him was sizing him up. Irman knew the old man would not try to fight him, and his youthful vigour would easily overcome the withered master. Even still, Ibrahim's summons still worried him; he had heard tales of his wrath, even as the Court knew his current state as that of a tame lion. He feared for his station, even as a humble servant of Ibrahim, words circled the court and the Iyaiid Assembly of his own prowess and how he himself would make a great Sealiph. Perhaps Ibrahim feared treason, but Irman would never! Though at times he pondered it, late at night when all is quiet.

Irmans' train of overthinking was broken with the command of Ibrahim. 

He spoke, stern and true, [b]"You will be my voice in Qartena Hadasht, you will go to the meeting, and there we will see if you deserve my endorsement, to be Al-Tuijayad."[/b] Irman stood there in shock, though his face did not betray him. To be Al-Tuijayad, the encrowned and endorsed successor? Indeed, the highest honour. Irman looked towards the Sealiph, [i]"I am ever the humble servant of Allah, and the Bearer of the Seal."[/i] Ibrahim nodded, [b]"Find a capable temporary replacement, then begone from here. A bright future is in your hands if only you secure positivity."[/b] Irman nodded. He turned on the spot and exited...

-

The plane descended, though the skies were clear, the wind whipped the plane, but it did not concern Irman, Allah has determined his life, and if he dies here. Then it is as it was meant to be. But it is not the end, and it lands. Smooth as can be, touching down on the tarmac of another nation provided a sense of importance that Irman had not felt since assuming his post as Commander of the Haras. The guard of the Sealiph himself. But now here he is, thousands of iolitars away from his family, surrounded by men in suits during his first-ever plane ride to meet a foreign people and discuss diplomacy. He had been tasked as the chief envoy on this expedition. A true test of his skill. 

The suit itched, formal wear made specifically for this occasion, to mimic Westerners. Though even still, at least his sword remains about his hip, and a traditional red fez atop his head. Irman stepped out of the plane and looked out towards the world, though he had seen the mixed old and new infrastructure from above. This place was indeed a sight to behold. He awaited someone to meet him, keeping a close watch towards the airport as the rest of the delegation readied themselves.

Upon deboarding the plane, he would see the beauty of Qartena Hadasht, and a warm wind would blow through his hair as he looked out over the tarmac. He was greeted by the Adir of Foreign Affairs Karam Eshmun and soldiers of the Sacred Band of Qartena Hadasht. The soldiers of the Sacred Band are wearing their ceremonial uniform, but are armed with their standard weapons. They perform a high step and salute upon him reaching the bottom of the stairs of the aircraft. Karam steps forward with an interpreter, he speaks. [i]"Greetings honored one, my name is Karam Eshmun and I am the Adir of Foreign Affairs. Thank you for coming to our great nation. If you follow me, I will lead you to our car so that we may go back to my office to begin our discussions."[/i] Karam would lead him back to a limousine that displayed two small flags of Qartena Hadasht above the headlights. A Soldier opened the door for the men and Karam would let Irman enter first. The soldier would close the door once both men were inside the vehicle and they would begin their drive over to the Government sector.
